verdict.rationale: Linear supports user-configurable agent behavior via 'Loops' (describe a job in plain language, choose schedule or event trigger) and explicitly touts building agents to 'investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback,' plus a documented Agents API/framework for creating and registering custom agents. This is more geared toward configuring recurring automations or building agents via API than a no-code, in-product agent builder for non-developers.  Missing for 10: a dedicated in-app agent-builder UI (choosing model, tools, memory, skills) for non-developer AI-native users, and independent/hands-on confirmation that end users (not just developers via API) can create fully custom agents.
